description: Requirement-to-case registry for the bounded nonblocking diagnostic sink (test_support/diagnostics.py). Host-simulation evidence only: nothing here qualifies the on-device render path or any physical/provider behaviour.

q00.diag.req.bounded_nonblocking.text: The diagnostic sink bounds event rate, queue memory and disk, never blocks or raises in the producer, and exposes exact dropped-event counts by reason.

q00.diag.req.critical_loss_invalidates.text: Loss of critical test evidence marks the result incomplete and a pass cannot rest on it; a sink that was never closed, hung, or lost its header/footer is not a pass on absence of error text.

q00.diag.req.sink_faults.text: Slow, full and unavailable log sinks are survived with exact loss accounting and do not change render-path results; real OS write refusal is exercised where the host supports it.

q00.diag.req.redaction.text: Tokens, keys, account and site identifiers, exact secret literals, the home directory and audio/binary payloads are redacted before they reach the log; member and group identifiers are pseudonymised.

q00.diag.req.log_audit.text: A written diagnostic log can be audited from the file alone: truncation, tampering, hidden critical loss and duplicated records are detected.

q00.diag.req.isolation.text: Diagnostics work from a non-root cwd with spaces in paths, isolate parallel run ids, never clobber an existing log, and clean up threads and file descriptors.

q00.diag.req.canaries.text: Planted diagnostic defects (uncounted critical loss, a lying footer, absence-of-error-text acceptance, a blocking emit) are each caught by the oracle that owns them.

Q00.AC2.full_slow_log_sink.text: Full, slow and unavailable log sinks are survived with exact loss accounting, never turn a pass into a clean result when critical evidence is lost, and do not change render-path results.

Q00.AC2.secret_redaction.text: Tokens, keys, account and site identifiers, audio payloads and exact secret literals are redacted before they reach any log, event stream or receipt.

Q00.AC2.parallel_isolation.text: Parallel runs are isolated by run id and by file, and an existing log is never clobbered or appended to.

Q00.AC2.non_root_cwd.text: Diagnostics work from a non-root cwd, including paths containing spaces, and a later chdir cannot redirect the log.

q00.diag.req.registry_integrity.text: The diagnostics case registry equals a floor derived from code that no manifest can edit, an undeclared skip makes a case incomplete rather than a pass, and case results satisfy the runner's result contract.

cases.description: Versioned JSONL envelope, pseudonyms, monotonic timebase, API shape and argument validation.
Queue/byte/rate/disk bounds, exact loss accounting, seeded randomized scenarios replayed byte-identically against the independent audit.
Critical eviction, lost-critical invalidation, per-case verdicts, absence-of-error-is-not-a-pass, late emit and close errors.

argv: /dev/full does not exist on this host
cases.description: Injected slow/full/unavailable/hung sinks plus real OS write refusal (RLIMIT_FSIZE child; /dev/full where present). INJECTED tests prove the reaction, not a real disk. The only declared skip is the Linux-only /dev/full test; on a host that lacks it the case still passes, and any other skip makes it incomplete.
A deterministic render stand-in with an independent state oracle gives identical results under healthy, slow, full and unavailable sinks; a blocking mutant is caught.
Key-name and value-pattern redaction, literals, home scrubbing, audio/binary payloads, truncation-boundary leaks, structure bounds, end-to-end no-leak.
Every strict prefix of a good log audits incomplete; tampering, hidden critical loss, overlong/garbage input and the audit CLI.
Non-root cwd, spaces in paths, parallel run ids, concurrent producers, cleanup on exception, no network/native imports.
In-process check that every planted diagnostic defect is detected, plus the positive twin.

The manifest equals the code-derived floor (thirteen planted disagreements and six planted skip-declaration errors are each reported), undeclared skips are incomplete, result documents satisfy the v1.1 contract, and the CLI enforces the policy end to end.
Known defect: a producer that does not count a lost critical event. The independent audit must flag it.
Known defect: a footer that reports no loss although events were dropped. The audit must flag it from the file alone.
Known defect: a checker that passes a truncated log because no error text appears. The audit must refuse it.
Known defect: emit() performs inline I/O. The nonblocking harness must see the producer hang while the sink is stalled.
